2317-4826-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Repeat.

883-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4770-6006-6090-6968.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5414-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5414-8095.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5414-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

851-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7782.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1274-4476-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4476-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3249-3967-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-3967-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

1558-3257-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-3147-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-3147-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2457-3129-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2292-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

849-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

1987-2364-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

275-2034-6351-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
275-2034-6351-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

81-292-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
81-292-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1879-3228-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

803-4508-6310.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Pirate" chosen.
803-4508-6310.description:
Activate Shao Jun by tapping two artifacts, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Repeat.
803-4508-6310.notes: Once you have one opponent remaining, the loop fails to create enough Treasures to sustain itself. You may use other artifacts as desired or wait another turn until your artifacts are untapped. If you have more than two opponents, this combo will net Treasure(s) per loop, and those can also be used once you only have one opponent remaining.

560-4550-4616-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-4616-5231.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {R}{R}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4136-4642.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4136-4642.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1479-3147-5361.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, Auton Soldier, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Auton Soldier and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Auton Soldier token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

204-1858-2056-2633-3480.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-3480.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1651-2797-4659.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

678-5037-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
678-5037-5147.description:
Move to your cleanup step.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile, triggering its madness ability, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blazing Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Once the stack is empty and all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs.
Repeat from step 2.

301-1988-2034-3020.notablePrerequisites: Blade of the Bloodchief is attached to Putrid Goblin.
301-1988-2034-3020.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding {C}{C}.
Puppeteer Clique dies, triggering its persist ability and Blade of the Bloodchief.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Puppeteer Clique enters the battlefield, putting target creature from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control until end of turn.
Resolve the Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Equip Blade of the Bloodchief to Puppeteer Clique by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Putrid Goblin dies, triggering its persist ability and Blade of the Bloodchief.
Resolve Putrid Goblin's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Equip Blade of the Bloodchief to Putrid Goblin by paying {1}.
Repeat.
